column1: # Japanese and cross-language golden pair set (feed/docs/clustering.md).
# Tab-separated like pairs.tsv: label  text_a  text_b; texts are what the
# embedder sees, headline " . " summary. For each of ten stories: a
# Japanese paraphrase (1), a Japanese syndicated copy with an agency mark
# (1), the same story in English and Japanese (1), a Japanese hard
# negative on the same topic (0), an English-Japanese hard negative (0),
# and an unrelated Japanese story (0). Sixty pairs, thirty positive.
# Meaningful only with the multilingual preset; the hash backend and the
# English MiniLM cannot pair across languages. Grow it from real clusters.
